turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I have not fainted again and the potassium result came back normal.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What happened next?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
How did that feel for you?
I called my father and told him, and he was silent for a long time and then said he would read about it.
Tell me more about that.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I went to a beginners' contemporary dance class, not ballet, and enjoyed it.
What happened next?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I keep coming back to it.
What happened next?
My grades are fine, and my tutor said I am on track for a high two-one.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
